create.title: Exact additive quadratic completion and terminal-symbol self-return
create.statement_tex: For the Round-58 high-shell core, 1_(h|n)chi_4(n/h)=-(i/(2h))sum_(a mod 4h)chi_4(a)e(an/(4h)). On every smooth interior radial piece, Poisson summation with r=4hk-a has n_*=4Xh^2/r^2, Legendre phase Xh/r, curvature -r^3/(32Xh^3), and stationary coefficient 2sqrt(2)e(1/8)chi_4(r)X^(1/2)h^(1/2)r^(-3/2). The identity 2h sqrt(X/n_*)=r restores exactly sum_j 1_(h<=H_j)Phi(h/(H_j+1))[w_j(r)]^*, including floors, hard top, and equality stars. For X asymp R^4, h asymp R, r asymp R^2, a length-R primal window gives an R-by-R raw reciprocal strip of capacity R^2, while the stationary coefficient is R^(-1/2); the required raw signed bound is O_epsilon(RX^epsilon). Under r=4Kh+s, det Hess(Xh/(4Kh+s))=-X^2/r^4 asymp -1 and both eigenvalues have order one with opposite signs, but this real determinant alone implies no lattice saving. A complete hard-symbol B-process, the raw signed strip estimate, and a lossless decomposition into the accepted terminal-M1 coefficient class remain open.
create.next_action: Audit the full fixed-relative-width critical radial block against the accepted terminal-frequency divisor theorem, with exact D,L ownership, Mellin or dyadic separation, endpoints, profiles, floors, stars, and transform errors.

update.next_action: Audit whether the full critical radial block, unlike a length-R short window, is a fixed-relative-width terminal M1 sector controlled by the accepted O_epsilon(1+D/L) theorem. Keep the exact angular symbol and all boundary owners.
The exact short core now has an exact reciprocal self-return, but its R-by-R signed strip remains open. Do not use determinant or counting alone.
Test the full critical radial sector only. The short-window moving strip is not in the theorem's separable coefficient class.
Use the exact coefficient self-return to distinguish full terminal sectors from short moving strips; product completion alone supplies no signed estimate.

reject.reason: A length-R primal window produces R dual integers for each of R frequency rows, hence raw capacity R^2; the stationary factor R^(-1/2) still leaves R^(3/2), not sqrt(R).
The integer phase Q(u,v)=uv has Hessian determinant -1 yet e(Q(u,v)) is identically one on Z^2. Modulo-one arithmetic and the actual character-weighted symbol are indispensable.

Exact differentiation after r=4Kh+s cancels the apparent order-R hh terms; the mixed derivative is order one, determinant is order one, and both eigenvalues have order-one magnitude with opposite signs.

The short radial selector 2h sqrt(X/B)<=r<=2h sqrt(X/A) depends jointly on h and r, whereas the accepted terminal theorem assumes a separable BV frequency coefficient and h-independent bounded denominator profile.
Artificial radial endpoints, profile and hard-top seams, independent stars, nonstationary integrals, and saddle-edge transitions require a separate uniform B-process ledger.

no_change.reason: The short signed strip, lower radial/frequency corridor, alpha transfer, and endpoint uniformity remain open.
The self-return reduction proves no discrepancy exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 59 proves the exact additive projector, stationary normalization, and coefficient-level return to the terminal M1 reciprocal symbol, while correcting two tempting scale errors. It rigorously shows that short-window completion retains an R-by-R signed strip and that Hessian determinant alone is insufficient. No shell estimate or exponent is proved.
